environment: Operational control systems functioning with basic protections
Partial access controls and physical security
Significant structural gaps in OT cybersecurity architecture
Very limited vulnerability management and secure configuration practices
primaryRisks: Lack of formal OT governance structure
Absence of OT-DMZ and strong network segmentation
Limited monitoring and incident response capability
s1_executiveSummary.takeaway: This maturity level places INALUM at elevated risk of production disruption, quality impact, and potential safety exposure in the event of a cyber incident.

indicators: Controls are mostly reactive or informal
Architecture not aligned to IEC 62443 best practices
Governance not yet structured at enterprise OT level

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS)
strengths: Safety interlocks exist at equipment level
SIS events likely stored in PLC/SCADA logs
gaps: No bypass logging or structured review
No independent safety logic review process
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: High (especially for smelter and furnace environments). Safety bypass could occur without detection. Undocumented safety logic changes.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: OT Governance & Risk Management
strengths: Corporate IT policies likely in place
gaps: No OT risk register covering safety/production impacts
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: No accountability framework. No visibility of OT cyber exposure at executive level.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: OT Asset Inventory & Visibility
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Obsolete assets unmanaged. Hidden integration pathways.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Architecture & Network Segmentation
strengths: No known direct PLC internet exposure
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Highest structural risk. Malware spread from IT to OT possible. No formal barrier between enterprise and control layers.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Identity & Access Management
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Shared or unmanaged accounts. Privilege creep over time.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Remote Access & Third-Party
gaps: No remote log correlation with MOC
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Vendor compromise path. Remote access abuse undetected.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Secure Configuration & Hardening
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Workstations may contain unnecessary services. Increased ransomware exposure. Uncontrolled system drift.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Vulnerability & Patch Management
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Lowest maturity domain. Legacy PLC/DCS unmonitored. Unpatched vulnerabilities accumulate.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Monitoring, Logging & Detection
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Attacks may remain undetected. No behavioral anomaly detection.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Incident Response
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Incorrect containment could disrupt production. No coordinated cross-plant response.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Backup & Recovery
s3_domainAnalysis.risk: Ransomware could encrypt backups. Recovery timeline unknown. Extended downtime risk.

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Physical Security
gaps: No formal OT log review process

s3_domainAnalysis.title: Quality / GxP-Impact Systems
gaps: Manual data entry reduces integrity assurance

s5_maturity.overall: Level 2 – Basic Operational Security (Below IEC 62443 SL2 readiness)

s6_businessImplications: Production downtime > 24–72 hours in worst-case ransomware scenario

s7_roadmap.principles: Secure the structural foundation and identity perimeter before scaling advanced monitoring. Establish governance as a prerequisite for technical control enforcement and visibility.

phases.title: Advanced Monitoring
phases.focus: IDS Anomaly, SOC integration, PAM, IR Playbooks.

pilots: OT-DMZ prototype implementation on primary smelting subnet.
Centralized alarm log pilot for critical furnace PLC cluster.
MFA enforcement pilot for high-risk third-party vendor remote access.
dependencies: Complete OT Asset Inventory with firmware/CVE mapping.
Firewall and Jump Server hardware procurement approval.

s8_conclusion.riskContext: The current 34.29% maturity score places INALUM in a High Risk category, particularly given the criticality of smelting and power generation operations.
